definitions.explanation: An item on a program or a performance presented at a festival, school event, cultural gathering, or entertainment venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出|だ}し{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めよう→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's decide on our attraction for the school festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{各部署|かくぶしょ}→各部署：29114_kakubusho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出|だ}し{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Each department was asked to prepare a performance for this year's year-end party.

notes:
Derived from ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out, to present) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing). Refers to anything presented as entertainment or as part of a program.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出|だ}し{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare a show/attraction
- {出|だ}し{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on a performance
- {出|だ}し{物|もの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: rehearsal for a show
- ⟦{余興|よきょう}→余興：28966_yokyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出|だ}し{物|もの}: an entertainment act

USAGE:
This word is commonly used in the context of school festivals (⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧, ⟦{学園祭|がくえんさい}→学園祭：19688_gakuensai⟧), company parties (⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧, ⟦{新年会|しんねんかい}→新年会：20392_shinnenkai⟧), and community events (⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧). Each group or class typically prepares a {出|だ}し{物|もの} — which can range from skits and dances to food stalls and haunted houses.
